topic: Search control counts need explicit initiation semantics

topic: Detached Preact roots can retain pending timers
problem: Tab replacement removes a container without Preact unmount cleanup
solution: Guard the actual search callback with connected input ref and test navigation
lesson: Navigation before timer firing must suppress a detached search callback; unmount cleanup alone is insufficient here

topic: Abrupt browser automation exits lose queued usage
